deletionScopeRules.DEL-001: DEL-001: Delete API registration and implementation for GET /v1/chats, POST /v1/chats, GET /v1/chats/:chatId, POST /v1/chats/:chatId/messages, share, unshare, delete-chat, and reset-chat.
deletionScopeRules.DEL-002: DEL-002: Delete apps/api product-chat route modules and every route-registry import or export that exists only for list, create, explicit-chat, share, unshare, archive, delete-chat, or reset-chat behavior.
deletionScopeRules.DEL-003: DEL-003: Delete packages/backend-domain/src/product-chats.ts, its package/barrel exports, and its dedicated tests after removing all imports.
deletionScopeRules.DEL-004: DEL-004: Delete API-client listChats, createChat, readChatById, sendMessageByChatId, shareChat, unshareChat, archiveChat, deleteChat, and resetChat methods. Delete product-client.ts if no retained method remains.
deletionScopeRules.DEL-005: DEL-005: Delete shared list/create/reset chat schemas, collection query schemas, share/archive/delete-chat contracts, explicit-chat access branches, optional chatId fields, and their exports and decoder tests.
deletionScopeRules.DEL-006: DEL-006: Delete every demo and web caller, hook, query key, route builder, controller, menu item, command, link, cache, and state field for multiple chats, explicit chat IDs, sharing, unsharing, archive, delete-chat, reset-chat, or new-chat replacement.
deletionScopeRules.DEL-007: DEL-007: Delete tests/platform-e2e/product-chat.spec.ts and all unit or integration tests whose only purpose is the removed product-chat contract.
deletionScopeRules.DEL-008: DEL-008: Delete the seven archive-reset cases from tests/e2e/chat.spec.ts and every fixture, selector, or helper used only by those cases.
deletionScopeRules.DEL-009: DEL-009: Delete the @hartlib/demo-data workspace package, its dependency declarations, barrel exports, fake accounts, fake plans, seeded issues, seeded publications, fake metrics, and all consumers.
deletionScopeRules.DEL-010: DEL-010: Delete all four checked-in demo fixture PDFs and all product code that loads static or IndexedDB PDFs, mirrors publication state locally, or clears those stores ad hoc.
deletionScopeRules.DEL-011: DEL-011: Delete the visible header reset button, its icon-only action, archive-and-replace controller, selected-storage clearing, and old reset API call.
deletionScopeRules.DEL-012: DEL-012: Delete product publisher route variants, path builders, resolvers, account switching, links, navigation, command entries, and production lazy imports. Keep only the unreachable packages/ui composition and its direct fixture entry.
deletionScopeRules.DEL-013: DEL-013: Delete gallery routes and production gallery imports. Keep the tracked ui-playground gallery only inside the permanent reference.
deletionScopeRules.DEL-014: DEL-014: Delete shipped reference mocks, service shims, translator code, visual generators, copied fixture data, and any runtime fallback that reads ui-playground. The original reference files remain untouched in ui-playground.
deletionScopeRules.DEL-015: DEL-015: Delete LegacyCitationRecord and every legacy citation transform, union branch, test case, documentation example, and accepted string or omitted quote form.
deletionScopeRules.DEL-016: DEL-016: Delete the active Pressroom OKLCH token values, 0.5px default radius, alternate old-theme selector, and any fallback that can restore those defaults.
deletionScopeRules.DEL-017: DEL-017: Delete scopePublicContentToMarket logic that removes subscribed:false sources or their publications, and replace the test that requires that behavior.
deletionScopeRules.DEL-018: DEL-018: Delete source invitations, invitation wording, seeded source rows, fake issue rows, fake source metrics, and Read/Unread state and controls.
deletionScopeRules.DEL-019: DEL-019: Delete any Regenerate or attachment UI, route, schema, dependency, storage, test, documentation, or hidden action found by the P1 audit. Do not replace them.
deletionScopeRules.DEL-020: DEL-020: Delete syntactic demo-cookie authentication and every helper or test that treats an arbitrary cookie-safe slug such as demo-user as an authenticated session.
deletionScopeRules.DEL-021: DEL-021: Delete old docs text, examples, fields, and links for /v1/chats, explicit chat IDs, multiple chats, share/archive/delete/reset, no Stop, done/error-only terminal events, legacy citations, routable publishers, fixture documents, invitations, and the old design defaults.
deletionScopeRules.DEL-022: DEL-022: Delete @hartlib/demo-data and product-chats dependency edges from package manifests and lock data. Delete each old-only UI dependency after the final import graph proves it unused.
deletionScopeRules.DEL-023: DEL-023: Delete any compatibility endpoint, alias export, compatibility view, repair function, old decoder, dual write, dual read, feature flag, or fallback that preserves removed behavior.
deletionScopeRules.DEL-024: DEL-024: Delete any apps/web file or export absent from the P1 named-use allowlist. A directory name, prior product role, or existing test does not count as a retained use.
deletionScopeRules.DEL-025: DEL-025: Do not delete or edit migrations 0001 through 0073 to perform this map. Migration 0074 must remove obsolete live objects and rows.
